text: Fig. 6 of the paper applied the domain classes to the best-family-filtered set: (family, target) pairs where hmmer's full-sequence score exceeds h_cut and neither nail nor mmseqs reports a hit, grouped by n_pos, hmmer's count of positive-scoring domain alignments (Measure.positive), at most 50 pairs per Pfam family, 283,397 pairs. At n_pos = 2 colinear dominates; at n_pos >= 3 pileup:fragment does. util::domains has used the paper's names since 7 Oct 2026.
